messages:
Kieran (CSM): Hey team — quick sync on Peregrine Health private deployment. They bumped the compliance checklist and asked for: KMS key in their account, VPC flow logs to their SIEM, IAM cross-account roles with least privilege, and an audit-log retention plan. Also flagged potential renewal risk if we can't meet SOC2 timeline.

Jamal (SE): Got it. I ran the compatibility check this morning. Their VPC CIDR overlaps slightly with one of our staging subnets — need them to confirm a new peer range. OpsBot kicked a network warning earlier: `peering_conflict: 10.0.0.0/16`.

Priya (InfoSec): For KMS, they want a customer-managed CMK in their AWS org and us to be a principal for encryption/decryption only. We'll need a constrained key policy + an IAM role assumption flow. I can draft policy.

Marta (CS Ops): I'm capturing next actions for the playbook. High-level: 1) ask customer for non-overlapping CIDR 2) KMS CMK ARN + key rotation window 3) list of SIEM endpoints for flow logs 4) IAM role ARNs we can assume. I'll send a templated checklist.

Jamal (SE): Sharing a quick snippet they can paste into their cloud team for KMS trust. They can edit the principals afterwards.

Jamal (SE): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodDecrypt",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::PEREGRINE_ACCOUNT_ID:role/redwood-remote-decrypt"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:ViaService": "ec2.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

Priya (InfoSec): That looks fine but tighten the Condition — restrict by `kms:CallerAccount` and remove `Resource":"*"` in favor of the CMK ARN. I'll patch and post.

Kieran (CSM): Customer asked about audit log retention options — they want 7 years for some records. Can we support long-term export to their S3/legal archive?

Marta (CS Ops): Yes — we can stream CloudTrail + flow logs to their S3 bucket via cross-account delivery. Need a bucket policy and a lifecycle rule. I'll include a template policy in the checklist.

Jamal (SE): Also FYI — performance note: if they enable very aggressive VPC flow logging (all traffic), it can spike cost. Recommend sampled flow logs and we can enable high-res for the first 30 days for onboarding diagnostics.

Priya (InfoSec): On IAM boundaries: ask them to provide the minimal role permissions. We should avoid wide `sts:AssumeRole` permission from numerous principals. Prefer a single role per environment with `Condition` checking `aws:SourceVpce` if they use VPCE endpoints.

Kieran (CSM): Renewal risk: they said legal needs confirmation that data residency + audit retention is possible before EOM or they'll pause payment runway. Let's prioritize the KMS + audit export docs this week.

Marta (CS Ops): I'll open a tracked enablement ticket and set a Due: 72h for initial templates.

OpsBot: automated-check: network_peering_overlap=true; suggested_action=ask_customer_for_alternate_cidr.

Jamal (SE): I'll draft the IAM + KMS samples and ping Priya for review. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Priya (InfoSec): I'll review and add the stricter conditions. Also suggest we include a short threat model note for their legal team explaining key ownership and rotation responsibilities.

Kieran (CSM): Great — I'll update Peregrine's AM and loop in their cloud infra lead. @Marta please add the checklist to the onboarding ticket and share the doc link.

Marta (CS Ops): On it. Adding checklist now and will post link here when ready. :thumbsup:

Kieran (CSM): Thanks everyone. Will follow up in 24h with the customer call notes and next steps.
